title: Guardian Readiness Framework
description: A structured readiness review that converts observations into a scorecard, recommendations, follow-up actions, and a 30-day improvement map. Covers physical readiness, digital hygiene, communication protocols, privacy habits, and situational awareness. Designed for individual operators and small teams pursuing lawful defensive education and readiness improvement.
